niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces with strong, obvious structure: clear sectioning, readable hierarchy, distinct titles, grouped content, and visible action/navigation cues. They consistently like polished modern layouts that feel intentional and easy to scan, often with cleaner spacing and reduced clutter. They also favor high legibility and strong contrast, especially when text and controls are easy to read and actions are explicit. In many cases they respond well to premium, modern presentation and integrated, understated components rather than bulky, noisy, or generic UI.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers screens with strong top-to-bottom hierarchy, clear section grouping, distinct titles/content/actions, and structured layouts over flatter or visually muddled compositions.
Prefers interfaces with strong text contrast, readable text treatment, and content that is easy to parse at a glance over low-contrast or visually obscured presentations.
Prefers explicit, visible controls such as labeled buttons, clear CTAs, back/navigation cues, and action treatments that make next steps obvious.
Prefers refined, contemporary, premium-feeling interfaces with cohesive styling over crude, dated, generic, or unfinished-looking UI.
Prefers UI elements that feel integrated into the layout—inline, flat, subtle, and not overly boxed, modal, shadowed, or visually detached.
Prefers screens that expose enough useful functionality, options, status, or support paths to complete the task clearly rather than sparse or incomplete flows.
Prefers information arranged for quick scanning—lists, concise grouped content, clear metadata, and digestible chunks—over compressed, monolithic, or poorly differentiated content blocks.
